purpose: Infra-only amendment of the v2 execution transport for the already-frozen Stage 3-5 capability qualification. Two LUNARC environment defects made the v2 sbatch die before any model output; this transport repairs exactly those defects and changes nothing scientific. Scientific panel/model/interface/thresholds/scoring are unchanged from STAGE4_EXECUTION_TRANSPORT_V2.

infra_change_record.defect: Retired module hierarchy: `module load PyTorch/2.1.2-foss-2023a-CUDA-12.1.1` returns RC=1 from any purged state (foss-2023a toolchain hierarchy retired LUNARC-wide; prerequisite spider lines empty). Under `set -euo pipefail` the v2 sbatch exited before the venv check, i.e. before any pre-receipt stage — a pure pre-receipt infrastructure failure, never a capability result.
infra_change_record.fix: Drop the module purge/load block entirely. GPU torch is provided exclusively by the pinned venv ($HOME/.venvs/rakl-paper4: torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 4.55.0, numpy 2.0.2).

infra_change_record.defect: User-site and login-shell shadowing: ~/.local/lib/python3.9/site-packages carries an older numpy (1.2x) and site PYTHONPATH pollution on login nodes can shadow venv packages, so an unisolated interpreter resolves different versions than the pinned venv.

scheduler_scientific_terminal_separation.principle: SLURM process health and the registered Stage-5 scientific terminal are separate coordinates. A complete valid receipt is harvested even when the model runner used a nonzero local code for a scientific negative/resource/degenerate terminal.
scheduler_scientific_terminal_separation.wrapper_rule: The sbatch wrapper captures the runner code, validates code-to-terminal consistency against the v2 receipt, then exits successfully so a valid scientific terminal is not relabelled as scheduler failure.
scheduler_scientific_terminal_separation.pre_receipt_infrastructure_failure: A failure before a valid v2 receipt exists remains non-COMPLETED scheduler state and is classified as execution/resource failure, never model capability. The v2 transport's module-load death was exactly this class; v2.1 removes the cause without touching any scientific coordinate.
